holidays.name: National Hug Your Cat Day
holidays.description: Today is the day to give your feline overlord a snuggle. Fair warning: the cat sets the terms. Some cats will purr through the whole thing, and others will squirm free and act like it never happened. Read the room, or the whisker twitch, and keep the hugs gentle.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance with no clearly documented founder. It has circulated on pet-lover calendars for years as a cheerful excuse to show cats a little extra affection.
holidays.funFact: Cats often show affection by slow-blinking at you. If your cat gives you a slow blink, you can blink slowly back, which many cat people call a 'cat kiss.'

holidays.name: National Old Maid's Day
holidays.description: This observance is named after the classic card game, and it has a tongue-in-cheek air. Many people take it as a chance to celebrate independent, single living, or to dust off a deck and play a few rounds of Old Maid. You lose by being stuck with the odd card, so nobody wants to end up holding the Old Maid.
holidays.origin: It is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It is tied to the long-popular card game, in which players pair up cards and try not to be left with the single unmatched queen.
holidays.funFact: Old Maid is one of the simplest card games there is. Because the loser is the one holding the odd card, it is a classic way to teach children about matching and bluffing.

holidays.name: National Cheese Day
holidays.description: This is a day to celebrate everything from sharp cheddar to stinky blue. Build a cheese board, melt something gooey, or try a variety you have never tasted. There are no wrong answers here, only different levels of delicious.
holidays.origin: It is an unofficial food holiday that has long been listed on June 4 calendars. It is a natural fit for a food people have been making for thousands of years.
holidays.funFact: Cheese is one of humanity's oldest prepared foods. Archaeologists have found evidence of cheesemaking that is thousands of years old.
